test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**unfavourable**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the aforementioned sentence, **even** emphasizes the **unusual **or **extreme **weather.
 
• **Unfavourable** as the **adjective **describes the weather conditions.

Hence the correct passage is: *The soya bean is called 'yellow pearl' by the Chinese. All the eight amino acids (1) that the body needs are present in it. It's a (2) rich and cheap source of protein. Even (3) unfavourable weather conditions can be withstood by this (4) hardy plant. Thus it is the key food that can (5) cater to India's future needs.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The use of **even **will seem **unusual **if the state of weather is **normal **or pleasant
